candidates.why_warranted: The exact incidence, planar order, two bigon faces and edge labels drive the curvature ledger and face words; a small drawing would let readers check the corners and orientation locally.

candidates.exact_claim: For transitive G on Ω and fixed α, assignments H ↦ H·α and B ↦ G_B give mutually inverse bijections between intermediate subgroups G_α≤H≤G and blocks B containing α.
candidates.why_warranted: The central result is an inverse correspondence between two differently structured collections; a paired map diagram could make domain restrictions and inverse directions immediately visible.
candidates.specific_content: Show the subgroup interval G_α≤H≤G on one side, blocks B⊆Ω with α∈B on the other, arrows H↦H·α and B↦G_B, and an explicit inverse/composition identity. Do not imply correspondence with blocks not containing α.
candidates.evidence_note: Tile shows both assignments and the stated point-containing-block restriction; no existing diagram.
